identity_and_scope.ko_candidate_basis: GoRatings EN/zh localized views for the same external player ID 21 publish Li Jie and 李劼 respectively; the profile pair also matches birth date 1983-12-04 and game 2013-01-21 vs Byun Sangil/卞相壹. An independent name reading determination for the complete published form segments it as Hanyu Pinyin [li][jie]. NIKL formal rules directly map li to 리 (Table 4 l→ㄹ; Table 5 yi(i)→이 with the preceding-consonant convention) and jie to 제 (j→ㅈ, ye(ie)→예, followed by the explicit 졔→제 adjustment). Tone is omitted. Thus 리제 is supported as a generated normative transcription candidate, not as a published Korean player name.
